name: Samuel Larsen
headline: Frontend and UI Engineer
summary: Versatile product engineer with a background in accounting and a strong focus on building clear, reliable user interfaces. Experienced in improving customer-facing flows, strengthening accessibility, and collaborating across product and design to ship measurable improvements.

roles.title: Accountant
bullets: Managed month-end reconciliations, invoice tracking and expense reviews for multiple business units, keeping records organized and audit-ready.
Prepared financial reports and supported payment follow-ups, resolving discrepancies that reduced open items by 18%.
Coordinated with internal teams to improve process clarity and maintain accurate documentation for routine operations.

roles.title: UI Engineer
bullets: Built interactive interface features in JavaScript with GraphQL and REST APIs, improving task completion time by 22%.
Developed and maintained automated browser checks with Cypress and Playwright, covering key customer flows across the product.
Applied Web accessibility practices to forms, navigation and content structure, helping pass review with fewer defects.
Partnered with product and design to refine UI behavior and edge cases, using JavaScript to keep the experience consistent.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
bullets: Shipped responsive views in HTML/CSS and JavaScript, connecting them to GraphQL and REST APIs for live data updates.
Expanded test coverage with Jest and Playwright, catching regressions before release and reducing escaped issues by 31%.
Improved Web accessibility across core screens by tightening labels, focus order and error messaging.
Reviewed implementation details with designers and engineers to keep the frontend aligned with product requirements.

projects.name: Pocket Gateway
projects.description: Created a compact customer portal in GraphQL and HTML/CSS, focusing on clear data display and fast navigation between account sections.
